ns2:section.sectionText: Online & Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. This section is a self-paced orientation course to the NRES MS program. The instructor will contact enrolled students via email or phone and provide them with course access instructions. This course section is open to any NRES MS degree-seeking student or graduate non-degree seeking student who intends to pursue the NRES MS degree. The graduate tuition rate for this section is $362 per credit hour; the undergraduate tuition rate is $325 per credit hour. All students in this section will also be assessed a $50 per credit hour administration fee. These per credit hour assessments are not included in campus range assessments.
